g.text: Can... I ask what your problem is with Arthur?
lmao. u just did u knobhead
u wanna know what the beef is between me n His Maj? i'll tell u. its 2 things
1. heroboy takes himself way 2 fking seriously
thinks he's still in the army. man has to step back n realize there r no rules in a place like this
n would it kill him to LAUGH once n a while?! sols tits! n people think i've got a problem
It's a lot of stress, being in charge.
u don't think i don't see that?! i'm not a fool, chief. don't assume shit just by lookin' at me
hero boy respects this lux set of skills, get me? its y he keeps me around, otherwise he wouldn't put up with my shit, still
what i'm sayin' is that heroboy needs 2 take that stick outta his fking arse
I KNOW. just bc the world's gone 2 shit doesn't mean u can't let off a little steam now n then
but he doesn't LISTEN 2 me. thinks i'm only good 4 1 thing. shooting 'n killing
it ain't doing NOBODY no favours. n is sure as shit driving me mental
thinks im just some yute ready to dash at the first sign of trouble. nah, cuz. not about that
Why *did* you stick around, when things started to get ugly here?
when the techrot started? shit. u jumping right 2 the deep end first thing
u don't know the 1st thing 'bout me, m8. get real. u from some future bullshit, u don't know where i'm from or what i've been thru
nah, chief. u can piss off with that
nah. i gotta trust u first b4 im gonna start telling u all the dirt, chief
nah. u gotta get up nice n close with me first b4 i start telling u all my secrets. gotta have a good reason 2 whisper in ur ear ;)
n we 4 nowhere NEAR there. u wanna work ur way up with quincy-k? u earn it first
Wait. What's the k stand for?
I have better things to do than play your games, sorry. [End.]
oh. u decided if the flirting bugs u?
killer. bc that's what i am. what this world made me in2. feel like u know what thats about, don't u
Does it mean anything? You flirting with me?
I've decided I'm game if you are. :)
I've decided I can do without it, sorry.
Uh - I have to go find a good reason - like right now - brb -
We just met and you want to start flirting with me?
Bit fast to start flirting with me, don't you think?

here's a tip 4 u, free of charge. just bc i like ur face. if it's super important 2 u, make ur question worth my time. gimmie something in exchange. this ain't all about u pumping me 4 intel chief, u read me?
loool u muppet. if u gotta ask ur screwed already. bf, here's a friggin' hint 4 u
u asking me if i'm ready 2 get on a knee?! shiiiit, cuz. really are a PROPER muppet
we just met n u wanna start asking me personal questions?
u really are a muppet, u know that? lol. u srsly don't know how to chill, do u
u really are a muppet, u know that? lol. mebbe. mebbe not. which do u want it 2 be?
skip the bullshit next time u wanna talk. cut 2 the chase. u wanna know whats up? ask. if i'm gonna tell u, i'll tell u. if i'm not, i'm not.
u hinted at that. n i'm dying 2 know more. u wanna fill me in? curious what a warzone looks like in freaky space future
this ain't ur first warzone is it. see it in ur eyes
we just getting started - this is just about u n me mutually appreciating some lux goods that's all
My life hasn't exactly been relaxing.
I don't know what you're talking about. I'm full of chill.
I'm certainly not going to turn it down.
I... haven't really made up my mind yet.
I'd rather you didn't, honestly. No offense.
this is just about u n me mutually appreciating some lux goods that's all lol
n if it's super important 2 u? make it worth my time. gimmie something in exchange. this ain't all about u pumping me for intel, chief, u read me?
Will you tell me about why you stayed here in exchange?
No. No it isn't. I was hoping to be done with terrified civilians.
No, but this is unique in its own right. I won't pretend to be the expert.
doesn't gotta go anywhere unless u want it 2. n not 4 nothing i don't exactly trust u yet lol
i knew u saw u something u liked when u rolled up. n not gonna lie...
no big, cuz. i know what i got is peng but i know its not 4 everybody
i knew u saw u some peng goods when u rolled up. n not gonna lie...
n u think mine's been, m8?! lmao u don't know the first thing bout me
mmmmmhm u keep telling urself that
if it bothers u, u just let me know n i stop. i know what i got is peng but i know its not 4 everybody
Fair. All right. Sure. Where's the harm with some fun banter? :)
I've decided I can do without it, sorry.
don't mind me the view too much either...
don't mind me the view too much either...
yeah fair u don't know me n i don't know u
ok so this war of urs. u wanna fill me in? curious what a warzone looks like in freaky space future
nice 2 know u know what u don't know
but we take this slow, yeah? plenty 2 do around here besides each other LMAO
but we take this slow, yeah? plenty 2 do around here besides each other LMAO
i knew u saw u some peng goods when u rolled up. n not gonna lie...
fair 'nuff, fair 'nuff. u tell me when u make up ur mind
oooh ur learning FAST lmao. yeaaah okay we can trade stories. but not 2day.
stories for when i don't think ur gonna snap n clap me when i'm not looking lol
don't mind me the view too much either...
but im not gonna lie, i don't mind me the view. u some peng goods, cuz
i gtg out on patrol, but we're gonna follow up rs
